rows.en: I-I'm taking my break now!!
She ran off like she was fleeing...
rows.notes: Shared; the player's line without a plate. Subject 'she' = Pinon.

rows.en:
Hehe, Pinon-chan's such a hard worker,
she'd never take a break unless we
pulled something like this.

Sorry for making you play
such a weird part...
Sigh~ What a shame, though.

Pinon-chan coming for a sleepover in her
maid outfit... Just imagining it makes me...
rows.notes: Claire; shared. Trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
(C-Claire-senpai?
Don't tell me she was serious just now...?!)
(W-well, no point worrying about it...)

(Okay, the Culture Fest is almost over!
I've gotta keep at it too!)

(Phew~ It's finally over~
We had even more customers than at last
year's Culture Fest. I'm totally beat.)
Good work to you too, Yuuto.

So the Culture Fest is already over...
It was so busy and so much work, but now
that it's ending, it feels kind of lonely...

What's with the gloomy faces?
There's always next year, so just
enjoy it all over again then.
rows.notes: Sheryl to Kagura and the player (the player has just agreed with Kagura); shared.

rows.en:
That's right, \p-kun!
We just have to make next year's
Culture Fest even more fun than this one!
rows.notes: Ranka. Subject 'we' restored: the class makes it more fun.

rows.en: Sheryl... Ranka......

You're right...
Yeah... Let's definitely do that!

(There's another Culture Fest next year.
I hope I can enjoy it with these friends
again.)
Welcome home, Milady!
Oh, wait... It's just \p-chan.

(So it's a cafe, all right...
a maid cafe...)

...Yui, you're the one who remodeled
the classroom, right?

(Like last year, can you really call this
just a remodel? I can see the ocean and
an artificial island outside...)
(Oh well... Better not dig too deep!)

I'm counting on you today,
\p-chan.
Welcome home, my lady.
Tell me about it...
Oh, you're in a butler outfit too, Luca-kun.

I see.
Huh? Come to think of it, where's Saotome-kun?

Oh, a butler outfit.
And here I was sure...

'I thought Saotome-kun would be in a maid
outfit'... Is that what you were about to say,
\p?
rows.notes: Alto quoting the female player's own form of address.

rows.en: N-no way, of course not...
I'd better go get ready for opening...
(Saotome-kun sure has it rough...)

(Right, I'd better hurry and get ready too,
or we won't be open in time.)

(Sheryl Nome's pull is really something.
The response is so huge we're swamped.)

\p-san,
please take the order at table 5.

Sure, got it.
By the way, Nanase, you've been working
nonstop this whole time. Aren't you tired?

\p-chan,
please take this to table 3.

Roger.
Are you okay too, Yuu? You've been
working nonstop this whole time...

(How should I put it...
those two run on the same fuel...)

You keep worrying about everyone else,
but what about you, \p-san?
Aren't you tired?

I'm fine.
What about you, Miyuki? Are you okay?

She's been working so hard with that
little body of hers...
Hey, Pinon-chan!
You look tired. Why not take a little break?

(She's definitely overdoing it.
She won't take a break no matter what I say,
so in that case...)
What is it, \p-chan?

(C-Claire-senpai?
Don't tell me she was serious just now...?!)
(W-well, no point worrying about it...)

(Okay, the Culture Fest is almost over!
I've gotta keep at it too!)

(Phew~ It's finally over~
We had even more customers than at last
year's Culture Fest. I'm totally beat.)
Good work to you too, Kagura-kun.

That's right, \p-chan!
We just have to make next year's
Culture Fest even more fun than this one!
Sheryl-san... Ranka-chan......

You're right...
Yeah... Let's definitely do that!

(There's another Culture Fest next year.
I hope I can enjoy it with these friends
again.)

\p, got a minute...?
There's something I want to give you.

It's my return gift for Valentine's.
I'd like you to accept it...
rows.notes: Kagura. Okaeshi = White Day return gift.

rows.en:
Thank you, Kagura-kun.
...Wait, what is this?

It's a book of aerial photos of ancient
heritage sites on Earth. They're so vast
and beautiful, aren't they?
Wow... Thank you so much, Kagura-kun.

I'm glad you like it.
I guess choosing it carefully paid off.

(He really put thought into a present
just for me... That makes me so happy.)
rows.notes: x3: the female player after the gifts from Kagura, Yamashiro and Luca, all male, so 'he' works for each.

rows.en:
(It's White Day today.
I wonder if Gary-sensei remembered?)

Hey, \p.
What are you doing in a place like this?
Mm. Once class is over, head on home.
Um, Sensei, aren't you forgetting something?

Hm? What is it?
If it's money, I don't remember
borrowing any...
Ugh, never mind! Excuse me!
Ah, \p, hold on a sec.
Yes?!
Here, this is for you. Hang on to it.
Sensei... this is...
Well, call it... thanks for the other day...
rows.notes: x3: Gary (White Day), Luis (White Day), and in Michel's White Day scene the row has no name plate (filed as the player) though it reads like Michel's line, probably a missing plate in the script. The wording works for all three.

rows.en: Well then, get home safe!

(A leather accessory, huh...
Gary-sensei's got better taste than I thought.)

Oh, Fresh Girl!
I was just looking for you.
rows.notes: Luis's nickname for the female player (fresh gaaru; 'Fresh Boy' for the male player elsewhere). Not in the glossary; kept as an English nickname.

rows.en:
My precious partner...
no, you could even call it my soul.
I'm giving this mic to you as a present!

Take good care of it.
This guy's a little on the delicate side.
rows.notes: Luis, speaking of the mic as 'koitsu'.

rows.en:
Shirakawa,
since it's White Day, here...
my return gift.

Oh, um... You didn't have to
get me a return gift...

uncertain: c23202: shared by Gary, Luis and an unplated row in Michel's White Day scene (filed as PLAYER); reads like Michel's line, probably a missing name plate. Wording fits all three.
c23205: Luis's nickname 'fresh gaaru' rendered 'Fresh Girl' (not in glossary; 'Fresh Boy' for the male player elsewhere).
missing_glossary: Fresh Girl / Fresh Boy (Luis's nickname for the player)
